verdict.rationale: Highnote documents that its in-house Disputes Team handles dispute/chargeback processes and mentions 'filing chargebacks for disputed transactions,' plus general webhook/notification infrastructure exists platform-wide, but there is no evidence of programmatic API/mutation-based dispute filing, network reason code handling, evidence submission endpoints, or provisional credit logic. missing for 10: API/mutation for filing disputes programmatically, network reason code taxonomy, evidence submission workflow/API, provisional credit issuance mechanics, dispute-specific status webhook events through resolution.
